 ‘Chalo Delhi’ posters dominate as INDIA bloc prepares for mega rally at Ramlila Maidan | LIVE
 INDA bloc's 'public impeachment' of CEC Gyanesh Kumar featured accounts from voters who alleged that their names had been deleted from electoral rolls
 Updated - November 01, 2026 10:53 am IST 
 The Hindu Bureau READ LATER 
 SEE ALL 
 Remove 
 Supporters reach at Ramlila Maidan ahead of INDIA Rally in New Delhi on November 1, 2026.
 | Photo Credit: 
 Shashi Shekhar Kashyap
 T he stage is set for the INDIA bloc’s mega rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan on Sunday (November 1, 2026), with opposition leaders and supporters from different states beginning to reach the national capital for a show of strength against alleged electoral irregularities and to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
 Posters announcing the INDIA bloc’s ‘Chalo Delhi’ march were put up outside Ramlila Maidan, as security personnel were deployed at the venue ahead of the Opposition’s mega rally on Sunday (November 1, 2026). A post by the Students’ Federation of India (SFI) also highlighted the rally, with preparations underway ahead of the event.
 The bloc carried out a symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, unanimously adopting a motion by a show of hands on Saturday (October 31).
 They levelled six charges against him, including conspiring with the ruling BJP to steal elections, deleting 13.2 crore voters through the special intensive revision (SIR) of voter lists, and acting at the behest of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah.
 Follow LIVE updates here 
 Key Updates
 Traffic curbs in Central Delhi on November 1 for INDIA bloc rally
 Ex-LS Speaker Meira Kumar sat on 'Nehru's chair' to preside over public impeachment of CEC
 November 01, 2026 10:53 Shivakumar backs INDIA bloc march: ‘Right to vote is the right to live’ Karnataka Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar, in Bengaluru on Saturday (October 31, 2026), said he wished the INDIA bloc’s march in Delhi “great success.” 
 “The right to vote is the right to live. Lakhs and lakhs of people have been deleted... It is our bounden duty to protect every voter,” he said, claiming attempts were also made to delete lakhs of voters in Karnataka.
 -PTI 
 November 01, 2026 10:28 Supporters gather at Ramlila Maidan, across capital Supporters of various INDIA bloc parties began gathering at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan early Sunday morning, while party workers assembled at different locations across the national capital ahead of the Opposition alliance’s ‘Chalo Dilli’ protest against alleged electoral irregularities and demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
 Samajwadi Party workers gathered outside party chief Akhilesh Yadav’s residence, while groups of Congress supporters assembled outside Himachal Bhawan before proceeding towards the rally venue.
 Many supporters arrived in Delhi on Sunday (November 1, 2026) morning, while several others had reached the national capital on Saturday (October 31, 2026) or earlier as parties mobilised their cadres from different states for the protest. -- PTI 
 INDIA bloc’s ‘Chalo Dilli’ protest: Supporters gather at Ramlila Maidan, across capital
 Opposition INDIA bloc mobilizes supporters for the Chalo Dilli protest in Delhi, demanding CEC Kumar’s resignation amid electoral irregularities.
 November 01, 2026 10:02 Nitin Nabin set to lead ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao’ march in Haryana’s Rohtak Amid the INDIA bloc’s mega rally in Delhi on Sunday (November 1, 2026), BJP national president Nitin Nabin is set to lead a ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao’ march in Haryana’s Rohtak to counter the Opposition’s narrative.
 Former Union minister and senior BJP leader Dharmendra Pradhan will also participate in the ‘Loktantra Bachao, Arajakta Hatao’ padyatra in Faridabad. The march will begin from B.K. Chowk at NIT, Faridabad.
 Mr. Nabin will lead the march against what the BJP describes as the Opposition’s “misinformation, propaganda and orchestrated chaos” on a day the INDIA bloc will hold a rally at Ramlila Maidan in Delhi against the SIR and alleged vote theft.
 Mr. Nabin’s padyatra will begin from Chhotu Ram Polytechnic Ground and culminate at D-Park in Model Town, where Mr. Nabin will also pay floral tributes to Mahatma Gandhi at his statue, the BJP said in a statement.
 The BJP said the initiative is far more than a political event; it represents a resolute ideological movement against the “falsehoods, conspiracies and unrest engineered by a desperate opposition”. -- PTI 
 November 01, 2026 09:33 Protest rally in Delhi for CEC resignation ‘stern warning’ to PM Modi, Shah: Venugopal AICC general secretary K C Venugopal on Sunday (November 1, 2026) said the party’s protest rally against CEC Gyanesh Kumar to be held during the day at Ramlila grounds in New Delhi was a “stern warning” to Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.
 Congress has alleged electoral irregularities and demanded the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner.
 Mr. Venugopal told the media in Delhi that it will be a protest like never before and that it has affected the composure of the PM and Home Minister.
 “They have lost their composure seeing the magnitude of the public support for the protest. That is why they are making statements that the protestors are anarchists and the agitation was an insult to the Parliament. The protest is a stern warning to them,” the Congress leader said.
 “Gyanesh will be removed from his post. Take it from us,” he added.
 Mr. Venugopal also said that it would be “good for the police” if they cooperate. -- PTI 
 November 01, 2026 09:16 Traffic curbs in Central Delhi on November 1 for INDIA bloc rally The Delhi Traffic Police has issued an advisory announcing traffic restrictions and diversions in parts of Central Delhi on Sunday in view of a proposed INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan, with a large gathering expected at the venue. The restrictions will remain in place from 10 a.m. to 5 p.m., and traffic movement on several adjoining roads is likely to be affected.
 The advisory lists several diversion points, including Netaji Subhash Marg T-Point, Rajghat, Delhi Gate, ITO A-Point, Ajmeri Gate Red Light, Ranjeet Singh Flyover at Barakhamba Road, Bhavbhuti Marg-DDU Marg Red Light, Jhandewalan Roundabout, Turkman Gate and Mirdard Chowk.
 Traffic curbs in Central Delhi on November 1 for INDIA bloc rally
 Traffic advisory: Central Delhi traffic restrictions, diversions, and bus routes for INDIA bloc rally at Ramlila Maidan, 10 a.m.–5 p.m., with alternate routes and public transit tips.
 November 01, 2026 09:14 Cutouts of Congress leaders outside Ramlila Maidan E-rickshaws pass by cutouts of Indian National Congress leaders Rahul Gandhi, Mallikarjun Kharge, Sonia Gandhi, Priyanka Gandhi and K. C. Venugopal put up outside Ramlila Maidan ahead of the "Save Democracy" march to be led by Rahul Gandhi, amid calls for Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar to resign, in New Delhi, India, October 31, 2026. REUTERS/Anushree Fadnavis TPX IMAGES OF THE DAY 
 November 01, 2026 08:49 ‘Chalo Delhi’ posters dominate as INDIA bloc prepares for mega rally at Ramlila Maidan Posters announcing the INDIA bloc’s ‘Chalo Delhi’ march were put up outside Ramlila Maidan, as security personnel were deployed at the venue ahead of the Opposition’s mega rally on Sunday (November 1, 2026).
 A post by the Students’ Federation of India (SFI) also highlighted the rally, with preparations underway ahead of the event.
 New Delhi, Oct 31 (ANI): Banners and posters put up along the roadside featuring Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and other leaders ahead of the INDIA bloc's scheduled 'Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao' rally at Ramlila Maidan, in New Delhi on Saturday. (ANI Video Grab)
 The INDIA bloc is organising the ‘Chalo Delhi’ march as part of its protest against alleged irregularities in electoral rolls and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.
 The protest follows the INDIA bloc’s public impeachment programme against CEC Gyanesh Kumar, held in the national capital on October 31.Meanwhile, New Delhi has turned into a high-octane political battlefield with two major showdowns unfolding side-by-side. -- ANI 
 November 01, 2026 08:30 Meira Kumar sat on ‘Nehru’s chair’ to preside over public impeachment of CEC The chair on which former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar sat while presiding over the INDIA bloc’s “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Saturday (October 31, 2026) was once occupied by the country’s first prime minister, Jawaharlal Nehru.
 The information was provided by Congress’ media and publicity department head Pawan Khera, who was involved with organising the symbolic public impeachment.
 “The chair on which Meira Kumar sat during today’s public impeachment proceedings against the CEC was once occupied by the first prime minister of India, Jawaharlal Nehru, the great-grandfather of Rahul Gandhi and Priyanka Gandhi,” Mr. Khera said on X.
 MeiraKumarSpeaker.jpg
 “It was Nehru Ji’s chair throughout his tenure as prime minister. It witnessed some of the most consequential decisions in our nation’s history and carries the weight of that legacy,” he said.
 Today, in that very chair, invoking the spirit of Nehru, former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar pronounced Gyanesh Kumar unfit to continue as the Chief Election Commissioner of India, Mr. Khera said.
 “Gyanesh Kumar has been rejected by the people of India. It is only a matter of time before he goes,” Mr. Khera said. -- PTI 
 November 01, 2026 08:24 Protests must be guided by national interest, says RSS leader Sunil Ambekar Everyone has the right to raise issues concerning the country through demonstrations, but such protests must be conducted with the national interest in mind, Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS) national publicity in-charge Sunil Ambekar said on Saturday (October 31, 2026). He also urged people to remain vigilant against attempts by anti-national forces to exploit public demonstrations.
 Mr. Ambekar was speaking to the media in Indore ahead of the RSS’ three-day national meeting, scheduled to begin on Monday (November 2).
 Protests must be guided by national interest, says RSS leader Sunil Ambekar
 RSS urges protests serve national interest, warns against anti-national exploitation while addressing UGC concerns and expanding global outreach.
 November 01, 2026 08:23 Rahul Gandhi appeals to Delhi rally goers to do festival shopping from local traders Amid concerns of traders in central Delhi over the impact of the crowd expected at the INDIA bloc’s ‘Chalo Dilli’ rally on Sunday (November 1, 2026), Congress leader Rahul Gandhi on Saturday (October 31, 2026) urged people to do some festival season shopping after attending the rally.
 In a video released late in the day, Mr. Gandhi appealed to people to shop for upcoming festivals like Deepavali, Chhath, and Bhai Dooj.
 Rahul Gandhi appeals to Delhi rally goers to do festival shopping from local traders
 Rahul Gandhi urges Delhi rally attendees to support local traders by shopping for Deepavali and other festivals.
 November 01, 2026 08:22 Oppositions in West Bengal question ECI over 16.10 lakh appeals against inclusion of voters Opposition parties in West Bengal have stepped up the heat on the issue of 16.10 lakh appeals filed against the inclusion of voters following the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) in the State.
 Leaders of the Mamata All India Trinamool Congress and the Communist Party of India (Marxist) have questioned the lack of clarity over who authorised the filing of the appeals after the SIR concluded in the State.
 Oppositions in West Bengal question ECI over 16.10 lakh appeals against inclusion of voters
 Opposition in West Bengal questions ECI over 16.10 lakh voter-inclusion appeals amid accountability concerns and SIR controversy.
 November 01, 2026 08:08 Watch | INDIA bloc rally: Preparations underway at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan 
 November 01, 2026 07:59 INDIA bloc rally 'serious political mistake', Rahul must introspect: Union Minister Hardeep Puri Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri on Saturday said INDIA bloc’s upcoming rally in Delhi is a “serious political mistake” and asked Congress leader Rahul Gandhi to “introspect”.
 Mr. Puri called the INDIA bloc’s Sunday (November 1) rally as “completely insensitive to the mass atrocities committed 42 years ago”.
 He noted that the trading community has also urged the Congress to reconsider the date of the rally in view of the festive season.
 -PTI 
 November 01, 2026 07:42 Dipke meets Mamata Banerjee; says CJP not to join INDIA bloc rally but supports cause Cockroach Janta Party (CJP) founder Abhijeet Dipke on Saturday (October 31) met Trinamool Congress supremo Mamata Banerjee in Delhi and thanked her for supporting the outfit’s youth-led protests, while extending solidarity with the INDIA bloc rally on the “vote chori” charge.
 He, however, said that the CJP would retain its independent identity and not join the Sunday protest by the opposition parties.
 Mr. Dipke said he had called on Ms. Banerjee to express gratitude for her support to the outfit’s first protest at Jantar Mantar on the NEET paper leak issue and her backing when its leaders Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were arrested by the Delhi Police.
 -PTI 
 November 01, 2026 07:25 Left leaders accuse CEC of eroding electoral democracy through SIR, demand his removal
 Left leaders on Saturday (October 31) accused Chief Election Commissioner (CEC) Gyanesh Kumar of undermining universal adult franchise through the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise, with CPI(M) MP John Brittas alleging that even elected representatives are being made to establish their eligibility to vote.
 The CEC has lost the moral and legal authority to remain in office, he asserted.
 Speaking at the INDIA bloc’s “public impeachment” programme, Mr. Brittas said citizens who had exercised their franchise for decades are now finding their names deleted from electoral rolls, being summoned for hearings, and being told to prove their existence.
 -PTI 
 November 01, 2026 07:17 ‘Make Rahul Gandhi a mock PM’: BJP slams INDIA bloc over mock Parliament The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) on Saturday (October 31, 2026) accused the Congress and its allies of ridiculing democratic institutions by staging a mock Parliament session, and said that Opposition parties had repeatedly disrupted proceedings in the real Parliament.
 At a press conference, BJP MP Sambit Patra referred to the structure resembling the old Parliament building erected for the mock Parliament session and said: “They want to retain everything from the old British-era structure... They should seat Rahul Gandhi ji as the mock Prime Minister in that very old structure. We have absolutely no objection.”

 ‘Make Rahul Gandhi a mock PM’: BJP slams INDIA bloc over mock Parliament
 BJP ridicules INDIA bloc’s mock Parliament, defends SIR, political double standards, and highlights alleged vote protection amid poverty claims.
 November 01, 2026 07:09 Ex-LS Speaker Meira Kumar sat on 'Nehru's chair' to preside over public impeachment of CEC
 The chair on which former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar sat while presiding over the INDIA bloc’s “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Saturday (October 31) was once occupied by the country’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru.
 The information was provided by Congress’ media and publicity department head Pawan Khera, who was involved with organising the symbolic public impeachment.
 Today, in that very chair, invoking the spirit of Nehru, former Lok Sabha Speaker Meira Kumar pronounced Gyanesh Kumar unfit to continue as the Chief Election Commissioner of India, Mr. Khera said.
 -PTI 
 November 01, 2026 07:04 INDIA bloc's public impeachment exercise against CEC Gyanesh Kumar drama: JD(U) The Janata Dal (United) on Saturday (OCtober 31) termed the INDIA bloc’s public impeachment exercise against Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar a “drama”, accusing the Congress of trying to push the country towards anarchy.
 JD(U) national spokesperson Rajeev Ranjan Prasad told PTI that the exercise does not reflect the role of a constructive opposition and that the entire episode reflects an extremist perspective and will not help resolve any dispute. “This is not going to resolve any dispute in any manner. It is an attempt to push the country towards anarchy,” Mr. Prasad told PTI .
 November 01, 2026 06:57 At CEC’s ‘public impeachment’, voters question deletion of names from rolls The Indian National Developmental, Inclusive Alliance’s symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar on Saturday (October 31, 2026) featured accounts from voters who alleged that their names had been deleted from electoral rolls during the special intensive revision (SIR) exercise.
 Among them was Anita Jaiswal, who moved from Kolkata to Delhi. She said she had voted in every election between 2012 and 2025 but was now being asked to establish her citizenship.
 Here’s the full story 
 At CEC’s ‘public impeachment’, voters question deletion of names from rolls
 Voters allege name removals in SIR; activists condemn EC during CEC Gyanesh Kumar impeachment at Kharge residence, New Delhi.
 November 01, 2026 06:57 CEC Kumar working under directions of PM Modi, HM Shah: Kharge Congress president Mallikarjun Kharge on Saturday (October 31) demanded the immediate removal of CEC Gyanesh Kumar and the scrapping of the 2023 law providing immunity to the CEC, accusing the poll panel chief of working under the directions of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah.
 “The Modi government has hatched every conspiracy since 2014 to cling to power: stealing MPs, breaking parties, stealing governments, electoral bonds, misuse of ED/CBI. And now vote theft -- cut opposition votes and rule,” he alleged, adding that there are hundreds of examples of “vote chori”.
 -PTI 
 November 01, 2026 06:56 INDIA bloc holds symbolic ‘public impeachment’ of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on six charges The Indian National Developmental Inclusive Alliance (INDIA) on Saturday (October 31, 2026) carried out a symbolic “public impeachment” of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar, unanimously adopting a motion by a show of hands.
 They levelled six charges against him, including conspiring with the ruling BJP to steal elections, deleting 13.2 crore voters through the special intensive revision (SIR) of voter lists, and acting at the behest of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah.
 Read the full story here 
 INDIA bloc holds symbolic ‘public impeachment’ of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on six charges
 INDIA bloc stages symbolic public impeachment of CEC Gyanesh Kumar on six charges, claiming electoral manipulation and threats to voters, prompting warnings to officials.
 November 01, 2026 06:55 Stage set for INDIA bloc's mega rally at Ramlila Maidan; leaders, supporters begin arriving in Delhi The stage is set for the INDIA bloc’s mega rally at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan on Sunday (November 1), with opposition leaders and supporters from different states beginning to reach the national capital for a show of strength against alleged electoral irregularities and to demand the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
 With a large tricolour canopy erected over the main stage, separate arrangements for representatives of INDIA bloc parties and security preparations in place, the Opposition is gearing up for a march from Minto Road to Ramlila Maidan, followed by a rally that is expected to bring together political parties, student groups and civil society organisations.
 The mobilisation is not confined to the alliance’s political constituents.
 -PTI
